description: Compensates one analyzer-equipped link from factory-state H/D singles tomography and a measured background, installs the estimated table without post-installation verification, and restores the exact pre-campaign source traffic, source attenuations and inline-attenuator settings; PA1000/PA2000 optical configuration is supported, while MPC320 requires driver support for readOpticalConfiguration. An explicit latchGuard policy is applied to every acquired window; required includes the network-resolved detector-health devices in the declared resource union.
summary: Estimate and install one link compensation table from separable H/D probes.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Exact lease union: emitting source, every inline attenuator that its carrier configuration may write, the resolved TimeTagger, and the resolved polarization analyzer.

items.description: One unique device identifier in the link-compensation lease union.

probeAttenuation.description: Total attenuation request used for both H and D probe traffic, in the ConfigureQuantumLinkCarrier attenuation form. Use mode perLink with every emitted source link when their required totals differ; the carrier distributes each total between the source and its inline attenuator.

mode.description: Carrier attenuation mode. This campaign normally uses perLink or common; networkConfigured is reserved for its final restore.

commonDb.description: Total attenuation on every source-emitted link when mode is common.

perLinkDb.description: Total attenuation by source-emitted link when mode is perLink. The carrier requires every emitted source link exactly once.

measurementDurationSec.description: Finite duration of each singles acquisition window, in seconds.

settleSec.description: Delay after carrier or analyzer-state changes and before the following finite measurement window, in seconds. The default preserves a one-second physical settling interval for analyzer rotations.

minTotalCounts.description: Minimum total background-corrected logical tomography counts required independently for the H and D source probes.

persist.description: Persist the installed compensation table on the analyzer DeviceOS host by default; set false for a nonpersistent installation. Persistence does not imply a physical acceptance gate.

latchGuard.description: Explicit finite-window latch policy propagated to background and tomography acquisitions. required rejects invalid windows and retries only after detector recovery; disabled deliberately acquires without latch protection.

mode.description: Whether per-window detector-latch validation is disabled or required.

maxWindowRetries.description: Maximum immediate retries of an invalid window after a recovered latch.

link.polarizationCompensation.plan.separ.description: Resolved source, carrier, analyzer, TimeTagger, and lease plan for the link compensation campaign.

link.polarizationCompensation.observatio.description: Background and factory-state H/D probe singles observations gathered before compensation installation.

link.polarizationCompensation.estimate.s.description: Calculated link compensation estimate, including the H/V/D/A/R/L retardances derived from the separable H/D probes.

link.polarizationCompensation.applied.in.description: Applied and optionally persisted analyzer compensation installation.

link.polarizationCompensation.status.cam.description: Terminal campaign status, any failure reason, and the attempted exact restoration of the pre-campaign carrier snapshot.
